title: Crate check fails before a Docker inspection
root_cause: The Rust source imports serde_json, but the crate manifest declares serde and regex without declaring serde_json. Cargo fails to compile; the missing image error is emitted by the shell's Docker inspection trap afterward.

relevant_evidence.why: The unresolved import appears before the Docker error.
The manifest lists dependencies without serde_json.
The source imports and uses serde_json.
The Docker command runs as an error trap for cargo check.
